literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 信任度下降、资金减少和政治纷争促成了这种容易预防的疾病再次回归。 [10.1126/science.aeo2672]
检测到麻疹病毒基因型B3和D8,以及21例与风疹相关基因型A病例。共确认了31例流行病学关联的麻疹病例,其中13例为基因型B3,17例为基因型D8。 [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.068]
几乎所有患有麻疹的孕妇(98%)在怀孕前未接种MMR疫苗或其疫苗接种状态未知,研究发现,在怀孕前接种MMR疫苗以及社区中高MMR疫苗接种覆盖率对于预防麻疹及其相关并发症至关重要。 [10.1056/evidpha2600416]
艺术媒介将复杂的医学概念转化为可操作的家庭建议,通常结合治疗指导(特别是饮食和支持性护理)与精神和护身符保护。 [10.1080/17533015.2026.2752310]

另一方面,世卫组织认为麻疹是一种可以消除的传染病,因为一种安全有效的疫苗已经可用,无症状感染罕见,有准确的诊断方法,并且人类是该病唯一的自然宿主;因此,世卫组织旨在消除麻疹。指南建议进行实时RT-PCR检测以检测病毒基因,并对检测结果为阳性的样本分析麻疹病毒 N基因的450碱基基因分型区域。269 麻疹是一种由麻疹病毒感染引起的急性传染病,主要症状为发热、皮疹和卡他症状。麻疹病毒具有极强的传染性。麻疹不仅可以通过飞沫或接触传播,还可以通过空气传播的传播传播。由于麻疹病毒也能感染免疫细胞,它会抑制感染者的免疫系统并导致各种并发症。呼吸道(肺炎、喉气管支气管炎)和消化道(腹泻、口腔炎)的并发症较为常见,以及中耳炎。神经系统并发症较少见但往往更为严重,包括麻疹脑炎,通常在感染后约两周内出现(每1000例麻疹病例中约有1例),以及亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE),其预后较差,通常在感染和恢复后数年甚至数十年出现(每数万例麻疹病例中约有1例)。世界卫生组织(WHO)报告称,2024年估计有95,000人因麻疹死亡,其中大多数为5岁以下儿童(https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/麻疹)。2005年,世卫组织西太平洋地区委员会(WPR)为。 [10.7883/yoken.iasr.557]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Eroding trust, decreased funding, and political strife aided the return of an easily preventable disease. [10.1126/science.aeo2672]

Measles virus genotypes B3 and D8 were detected, together with 21 vaccine-associated genotype A cases. Thirty-one epidemiologically confirmed outbreaks were identified, comprising 13 genotype B3 outbreaks and 17 genotype D8 outbreaks. [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.068]

Almost all pregnant women with measles (98%) had not received MMR vaccination before pregnancy or had unknown vaccination status, and MMR vaccination before pregnancy and high community MMR vaccination coverage were found to be important to prevent measles and related complications. [10.1056/evidpha2600416]

Artistic media translated complex medical ideas into actionable household advice, commonly combining regimen guidance (notably diet and supportive care) with spiritual and talismanic protection. [10.1080/17533015.2026.2752310]

In 2025, 265 measles cases were reported, with 194 cases having detectable viral genes and 186 cases having a determined genotype. Of these, 163 were genotype B3 and 23 were genotype D8. Additionally, 66 cases were suspected to have been infected overseas, while domestic infection was suspected in at least 60% of cases. [10.7883/yoken.iasr.557]

[10.1126/science.aeo2672]. Measles virus genotypes B3 and D8 were detected, together with 21 vaccine-associated genotype A cases. Almost all pregnant women with measles (98%) had not received MMR vaccination before pregnancy or had unknown vaccination status, and MMR vaccination before pregnancy and high community MMR vaccination coverage were found to be important to prevent measles and related complications. Artistic media translated complex medical ideas into actionable household advice, commonly combining regimen guidance (notably diet and supportive care) with spiritual and talismanic protection.

papers.title: 2025 Annual Australian Measles and Rubella Genotyping Surveillance Program Report.
papers.abstract: Molecular characterisation is a critical component of Australia's measles and rubella surveillance systems, supporting outbreak investigations, identifying sources of infection, and providing evidence for the continued maintenance of Australia's measles and rubella elimination status. This annual report summarises measles and rubella molecular epidemiology in Australia during 2025 and evaluates the utility of whole genome sequencing (WGS) for measles surveillance. In 2025, there were 181 confirmed measles cases notified in Australia, representing a 217.5% increase on the number notified in 2024. Measles virus genotypes B3 and D8 were detected, together with 21 vaccine-associated genotype A cases. Genotype B3 predominated during the first half of the year and was largely associated with importations from Vietnam, whereas genotype D8 predominated during the second half of the year and was primarily associated with importations from Indonesia. Thirty-one epidemiologically confirmed outbreaks were identified, comprising 13 genotype B3 outbreaks and 17 genotype D8 outbreaks. The discriminatory power and concordance with epidemiological data in the context of outbreak investigations was substantially greater for WGS data than for conventional N450-based genotyping. Viruses sharing the same N450-based distinct sequence identifier (DSid) differed by up to 33 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) for genotype B3 and 36 SNPs for genotype D8, whereas genomes obtained from epidemiologically linked cases differed by a maximum of four SNPs. Despite increased national case numbers in 2025, available molecular and epidemiological evidence indicated that cases were associated with importations or import-related transmission events, with no evidence of sustained endemic measles transmission. Rubella activity remained extremely low, with no rubella virus detections identified among 157 specimens tested by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and only two notified cases nationally, neither of which had material available for genotyping. These findings support the continued absence of endemic measles and rubella transmission in Australia and highlight the value of WGS for enhancing measles surveillance and outbreak investigations.

papers.title_zh: 2025年澳大利亚麻疹和风疹基因分型监测计划报告。
papers.source_body_en: Molecular characterisation is a critical component of Australia's measles and rubella surveillance systems, supporting outbreak investigations, identifying sources of infection, and providing evidence for the continued maintenance of Australia's measles and rubella elimination status. This annual report summarises measles and rubella molecular epidemiology in Australia during 2025 and evaluates the utility of whole genome sequencing (WGS) for measles surveillance. In 2025, there were 181 confirmed measles cases notified in Australia, representing a 217.5% increase on the number notified in 2024. Measles virus genotypes B3 and D8 were detected, together with 21 vaccine-associated genotype A cases. Genotype B3 predominated during the first half of the year and was largely associated with importations from Vietnam, whereas genotype D8 predominated during the second half of the year and was primarily associated with importations from Indonesia. Thirty-one epidemiologically confirmed outbreaks were identified, comprising 13 genotype B3 outbreaks and 17 genotype D8 outbreaks. The discriminatory power and concordance with epidemiological data in the context of outbreak investigations was substantially greater for WGS data than for conventional N450-based genotyping. Viruses sharing the same N450-based distinct sequence identifier (DSid) differed by up to 33 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) for genotype B3 and 36 SNPs for genotype D8, whereas genomes obtained from epidemiologically linked cases differed by a maximum of four SNPs. Despite increased national case numbers in 2025, available molecular and epidemiological evidence indicated that cases were associated with importations or import-related transmission events, with no evidence of sustained endemic measles transmission. Rubella activity remained extremely low, with no rubella virus detections identified among 157 specimens tested by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and only two notified cases nationally, neither of which had material available for genotyping. These findings support the continued absence of endemic measles and rubella transmission in Australia and highlight the value of WGS for enhancing measles surveillance and outbreak investigations.
papers.abstract_zh: 分子特征分析是澳大利亚麻疹和风疹监测系统的关键组成部分,支持麻疹病例调查、确定感染源,并为维持澳大利亚麻疹和风疹消除状态提供证据。本年度报告总结了2025年澳大利亚麻疹和风疹的分子监测情况,并评估了全基因组测序(WGS)在麻疹基因分型中的应用价值。2025年,澳大利亚报告了181例确认的麻疹病例,较2024年通知的病例数增加了217.5%。检测到麻疹病毒基因型B3和D8,以及21例与风疹相关基因型A病例。基因型B3在上半年占主导地位,主要与从越南输入的病例相关,而基因型D8在下半年占主导地位,主要与从印度尼西亚输入的病例相关。共确认了31例流行病学关联的麻疹病例,其中13例为基因型B3,17例为基因型D8。在麻疹病例调查的背景下,WGS数据在区分能力及与流行病学数据的一致性方面均显著优于传统的基于N450的基因分型方法。在基因型B3中,共享相同N450基序的病毒株之间存在多达33个单核苷酸多态性(SNPs),而在基因型D8中则存在多达36个SNPs;然而,从流行病学关联病例中获得的病毒株之间最多仅存在4个SNPs。尽管2025年全国麻疹病例数量有所增加,但现有的分子和流行病学证据表明,病例主要与输入或输入相关事件有关,没有证据表明存在持续的地方性麻疹传播。风疹活动仍然非常低,通过聚合酶链反应(PCR)检测的157份样本中未发现风疹病毒,全国仅报告了2例病例,且这两例均未提供可用于基因分型的样本。这些发现支持了澳大利亚持续不存在地方性麻疹和风疹传播的结论,并突显了WGS在提升麻疹基因分型和麻疹病例调查中的重要价值。

papers.title: Outcomes among Pregnant Women with Measles and Their Infants in the United States - Preliminary Analysis, 2025-2026.
papers.abstract: AbstractMeasles virus infection during pregnancy can result in severe maternal illness, adverse pregnancy and infant outcomes, and neonatal complications, including congenital measles. During multiple large outbreaks from January 1, 2025, to September 28, 2026, a total of 112 cases of confirmed measles during pregnancy and 13 cases of congenital measles were reported to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; complications included maternal pneumonia, preterm delivery, and neonatal complications. Almost all pregnant women with measles (98%) had not received measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination before pregnancy or had unknown vaccination status. MMR vaccination before pregnancy and high community MMR vaccination coverage are important to prevent measles and related complications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解2025年1月1日至2026年9月28日期间多次大型暴发中,患有麻疹的孕妇及其婴儿的结局,鉴于已知麻疹在妊娠期间与严重的母体和新生儿并发症相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及向疾病控制与预防中心报告的112例妊娠期间确诊的麻疹病例和13例先天性麻疹病例,其并发症包括母体肺炎、早产和新生儿并发症。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究分析了报告病例的数据,关注母体和新生儿结局,并强调了在怀孕前接种MMR疫苗对于预防麻疹及其相关并发症的重要性。
elements_zh.main_results: 几乎所有患有麻疹的孕妇(98%)在怀孕前未接种MMR疫苗或其疫苗接种状态未知,研究发现,在怀孕前接种MMR疫苗以及社区中高MMR疫苗接种覆盖率对于预防麻疹及其相关并发症至关重要。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释了这些发现,强调在怀孕前接种MMR疫苗对于预防麻疹及其并发症的关键作用,并突出了提高疫苗接种覆盖率的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为公共卫生策略提供信息,以提高疫苗接种覆盖率,从而预防妊娠期间麻疹病毒及其相关并发症对母体和新生儿的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于对报告病例的依赖以及缺乏详细的干预方案,但证据表明在怀孕前接种MMR 疫苗接种的重要性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:妊娠期间麻疹病毒感染可能导致严重的母体疾病、不良的妊娠和婴儿结局以及新生儿并发症,包括先天性麻疹。在2025年1月1日至2026年9月28日期间发生的多次大型暴发中,向疾病控制与预防中心报告了112例妊娠期间确诊的麻疹病例和13例先天性麻疹病例;并发症包括母体肺炎、早产和新生儿并发症。几乎所有患有麻疹的孕妇(98%)在怀孕前未接种麻疹-麻疹-腮腺炎(MMR)疫苗或其疫苗接种状态未知。在怀孕前接种MMR疫苗以及社区中高MMR疫苗接种覆盖率对于预防麻疹及其相关并发症至关重要。

papers.title: The historical evolution of measles treatment in Japan visualised through Japanese artwork and woodblock prints.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Measles epidemics recurred for centuries in Japan. In the pre-modern era, management drew on kampō (Chinese-influenced) medicine, folk remedies, religious rituals, and talismanic practices. Visual culture often mediated between medical knowledge and the public, especially during crises such as the 1862 measles outbreak and later during the Meiji-era transition toward modern scientific medicine. METHODS: We conducted an interdisciplinary medical humanities study using historical inquiry and qualitative visual analysis. A curated corpus of Japanese visual materials - including kampō medical illustrations, hashika-e (measles woodblock prints), and depictions of early quarantine and containment - was analysed to determine how images and accompanying texts communicated symptom recognition, therapeutic regimens, protective practices, and public-facing guidance. Interpretations were contextualised using contemporaneous writings and relevant secondary scholarship. RESULTS: Artistic media translated complex medical ideas into actionable household advice, commonly combining regimen guidance (notably diet and supportive care) with spiritual and talismanic protection. During epidemic periods, particularly 1862, hashika-e functioned as mass-circulating public health messaging, shaping perceptions of authority, mobilising lay participation, and at times expressing satire or moral critique. Across eras, the visual record tracks a gradual paradigm shift from predominantly spiritual explanatory frameworks toward modern scientific governance, including containment practices and vaccination-oriented prevention. CONCLUSION: Japanese artworks and printed ephemera offer a distinctive lens on the co-evolution of measles management, culture, and trust. Japan's eventual measles elimination can be understood as a socio-technical achievement in which biomedical advances were reinforced by culturally resonant visual strategies that supported public confidence and cooperation.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹疫情在日本持续数个世纪。在近代之前,管理措施借鉴了汉方医学、民间疗法、宗教仪式和护身符习俗。视觉文化常常在医学知识与公众之间起到中介作用,尤其是在1862年麻疹 暴发疫情等危机期间,以及后来明治时代向现代科学医学过渡的时期。方法:我们采用跨学科的医学人文研究方法,结合历史研究和定性视觉分析。对一组精选的日本视觉材料(包括汉方医学插图、hashika-e(麻疹木版画)以及早期隔离和防控的描绘)进行了分析,以确定图像和相关文字如何传达症状识别、治疗方案、防护措施和面向公众的指导。解释基于同时代的文献和相关次级学术研究。结果:艺术媒介将复杂的医学概念转化为可操作的家庭建议,通常结合治疗指导(特别是饮食和支持性护理)与精神和护身符保护。在疫情时期,尤其是1862年,hashika-e作为大众传播的公共卫生信息,塑造了权威形象,动员了普通民众的参与,并在某些情况下表达了讽刺或道德批评。在不同时期,视觉记录显示了从以精神解释框架为主的模式逐渐向现代科学治理转变,包括防控措施和以疫苗接种为导向的预防。结论:日本的艺术作品和印刷品提供了独特的视角,审视麻疹管理、文化与信任之间的相互作用。日本最终消除麻疹可以被视为一项社会技术成就,其中生物医学进展得到了与文化相契合的视觉策略的支持,从而增强了公众信心和合作。

papers.title: Fourteen years of measles surveillance in Sicily: epidemiological trends, adult susceptibility, and age-specific clinical profiles.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Measles remains a major public health concern globally, including in high-income countries and European regions where vaccination coverage is insufficient to interrupt transmission. We analysed long-term surveillance data to describe measles epidemiology in Sicily and clinical profiles over a 14-year period. METHODS: Laboratory-confirmed cases reported from July 2012 to May 2026 were analysed by demographics, vaccination status, healthcare setting, symptoms, complications, and time. Descriptive tests, univariate logistic regression, and phi coefficients assessed age-related associations and symptom co-occurrence. RESULTS: Among 1,169 cases, the largest wave occurred in 2018 (598; 51.1%). After no reported circulation during 2020-2023, transmission re-emerged in 2024. Most patients were unvaccinated (93.5%); adults accounted for 60.7% of cases, including 46 healthcare workers (6.5% of adult cases). Approximately threee-quarters of cases were hospital-managed and, among these, 51.8% showed clinical complications. Adults had higher odds of complications than children in community-managed (OR 2.89) and hospital-managed cases (OR 1.94). The respiratory-mucosal pattern occurred in 48.0% and was more frequent in hospital-managed patients (51.1% vs 38.4%). The lympho-articular pattern was rare (3.2%) and adult-specific. CONCLUSION: Re-emergence reflects persistent immunity gaps. Findings support high two-dose childhood coverage, catch-up vaccination for adolescents and adults, and systematic healthcare-worker immunity assessment. These findings highlight persistent susceptibility across age groups and the need for laboratory-supported surveillance and effective targeted elimination strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹仍然是全球主要的公共卫生问题,包括在高收入国家和欧洲地区,这些地区疫苗接种覆盖率不足,无法中断传播传播。我们分析了长期的监测数据,以描述西西里岛14年期间的麻疹疫情及临床特征。方法:分析了2012年7月至2026年5月期间报告的实验室确诊病例,按人口统计学特征、疫苗接种状态、医疗环境、症状、并发症和时间进行分类。使用描述性统计、单变量逻辑回归和phi系数评估年龄相关关联和症状共现情况。结果:在1,169例病例中,2018年出现最大疫情波(598例;51.1%)。在2020年至2023年期间未报告传播,但2024年传播重新出现。大多数患者未接种疫苗(93.5%);成人病例占60.7%,其中包括46名医护人员(成人病例的6.5%)。约四分之三的病例由医院管理,其中51.8%出现临床并发症。在社区管理病例中,成人出现并发症的风险高于儿童(OR 2.89),在医院管理病例中,成人出现并发症的风险也高于儿童(OR 1.94)。呼吸道黏膜模式占48.0%,在医院管理患者中更为常见(51.1% vs 38.4%)。淋巴关节模式罕见(3.2%),且仅见于成人。结论:疫情重新出现反映了持续的免疫缺口。研究结果支持儿童高覆盖率的两剂疫苗接种、青少年和成人补种疫苗接种以及系统性的医护人员免疫评估。这些发现突显了各年龄段持续的易感性,并强调了需要实验室支持的监测监测和有效的针对性消除策略。

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
papers.source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

papers.title: Delayed Recognition of Measles Cluster Outbreaks in a High-Vaccination-Coverage Setting: Epidemiological and Clinical Characteristics of Primary and Index Cases with Different Immune Statuses, Henan Province, China, 2025
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Under high measles vaccination coverage, breakthrough infections often present with mild, atypical features that may delay outbreak recognition. We characterized measles cluster outbreaks in a high-coverage setting, focusing on the interval between primary-case and index-case onset as a measure of delayed outbreak recognition. Methods: We investigated three measles cluster outbreaks comprising 66 laboratory-confirmed cases reported in Henan Province, China, in 2025, using field investigation and laboratory testing, and compared clinical manifestations by immunization status; because of profound age differences between immunization groups, comparisons were presented descriptively. Results: The interval from primary- to index-case onset ranged from 4 to 15 days, representing an upper-bound estimate of the recognition delay. All three primary cases had received two doses of measles-containing vaccine (MCV) and presented with low-grade fever and localized rash, whereas none of the four index cases had an MCV history and all had peak temperatures ≥39 °C. Among the 21 infected close contacts identified from 100 screened close contacts, 84.6% (11/13) of vaccinated (≥1 dose) individuals were asymptomatic or mild, versus 37.5% (3/8) of unvaccinated or status-unknown individuals. Among cases with documented immunization history, pneumonia (17.4% vs. 37.5%) and hospitalization (43.5% vs. 62.5%) were less frequent in vaccinated than in unvaccinated cases; these unadjusted differences were confounded by age and are presented descriptively. Conclusions: Breakthrough measles infections in high-coverage settings have atypical presentation and mild symptoms. Such infections may lead to unrecognized community transmission. Surveillance should incorporate active case finding for atypical presentations in high-coverage high-density settings.

The findings highlight the atypical presentation of measles in high-vaccination settings and suggest the need for improved surveillance to detect such cases. The study's limitations include potential confounding by age and limited generalizability due to the small number of outbreaks analyzed.

papers.title_zh: 高覆盖率环境下麻疹簇暴发的延迟识别:河南省2025年不同免疫状态的首发病例和指数病例的流行病学与临床特征
papers.source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Under high measles vaccination coverage, breakthrough infections often present with mild, atypical features that may delay outbreak recognition. We characterized measles cluster outbreaks in a high-coverage setting, focusing on the interval between primary-case and index-case onset as a measure of delayed outbreak recognition. Methods: We investigated three measles cluster outbreaks comprising 66 laboratory-confirmed cases reported in Henan Province, China, in 2025, using field investigation and laboratory testing, and compared clinical manifestations by immunization status; because of profound age differences between immunization groups, comparisons were presented descriptively. Results: The interval from primary- to index-case onset ranged from 4 to 15 days, representing an upper-bound estimate of the recognition delay. All three primary cases had received two doses of measles-containing vaccine (MCV) and presented with low-grade fever and localized rash, whereas none of the four index cases had an MCV history and all had peak temperatures ≥39 °C. Among the 21 infected close contacts identified from 100 screened close contacts, 84.6% (11/13) of vaccinated (≥1 dose) individuals were asymptomatic or mild, versus 37.5% (3/8) of unvaccinated or status-unknown individuals. Among cases with documented immunization history, pneumonia (17.4% vs. 37.5%) and hospitalization (43.5% vs. 62.5%) were less frequent in vaccinated than in unvaccinated cases; these unadjusted differences were confounded by age and are presented descriptively. Conclusions: Breakthrough measles infections in high-coverage settings have atypical presentation and mild symptoms. Such infections may lead to unrecognized community transmission. Surveillance should incorporate active case finding for atypical presentations in high-coverage high-density settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:在高疫苗接种覆盖率下,突破性感染常表现出轻微、非典型的症状,这可能会延迟对感染的识别。我们对高覆盖率环境下麻疹病毒(麻疹病毒)的暴发进行了特征分析,重点关注首发病例与索引病例发病时间间隔作为延迟识别的衡量指标。方法:我们通过现场调查和实验室检测,对河南省2025年报告的66例实验室确诊的麻疹病毒暴发病例进行了研究,并比较了不同疫苗接种状态下的临床表现;由于疫苗接种组之间存在显著的年龄差异,比较结果以描述性方式呈现。结果:首发病例到索引病例发病的时间间隔为4至15天,代表了识别延迟的上限估计。所有三个首发病例均接种了两剂含麻疹成分的疫苗(MCV),并表现出低热和局部皮疹,而四个索引病例均无MCV接种史,且最高体温均≥39 °C。在100名密切接触者中筛查出21名感染病例,其中13名接种过疫苗(≥1剂)的密切接触者中有84.6%(11/13)为无症状或轻症,而8名未接种或接种状态未知的密切接触者中有37.5%(3/8)为无症状或轻症。在有明确疫苗接种史的病例中,接种疫苗者比未接种者肺炎发生率(17.4% vs. 37.5%)和住院率(43.5% vs. 62.5%)均较低;这些未调整的差异受到年龄的影响,因此以描述性方式呈现。结论:在高覆盖率环境下,突破性麻疹病毒感染表现出非典型症状和轻微症状。此类感染可能导致社区中未被识别的传播。在高覆盖率和高密度环境下,监测系统应纳入对非典型表现的主动病例发现。

papers.title: An update to the critical vaccination threshold for measles herd immunity
papers.abstract: Abstract Recent evidence indicates that measles vaccine-induced immunity may wane over time, challenging the classical assumption of lifelong protection. We develop a mathematical model of measles transmission and vaccination that explicitly incorporates waning immunity and derive updated expressions for the critical vaccination threshold ( $$p_c$$ ) and control reproduction number ( $$R_c$$ ), two cornerstone metrics used to guide public health vaccination policy. We additionally derive equations for outbreak probability and final outbreak size. We apply the model to the 2024-2025 measles outbreak in the Southwestern Ontario Public Health Region and report ranges of the basic reproduction number ( $$R_0$$ ), outbreak peak timing and magnitude, final outbreak size, and the size of the population involved in transmission from feasible parameter sets that satisfy observed epidemic characteristics. Most importantly, our analysis reveals that even extremely slow waning of vaccine-induced immunity – effectively corresponding to lifelong protection – can fundamentally alter herd immunity dynamics. Specifically, under the model assumptions, we identify realistic parameter regimes in which vaccine-induced herd immunity cannot be achieved, despite high vaccine coverage. Nevertheless, outbreak risk under these conditions may still remain very low. These findings suggest that widely used measles herd immunity thresholds may require re-evaluation in highly vaccinated populations.

The research challenges the classical assumption of lifelong vaccine-induced protection and applies the model to the 2024-2025 measles outbreak in Southwestern Ontario. The findings reveal that even with slow waning immunity, herd immunity may not be achievable in highly vaccinated populations, suggesting the need for re-evaluation of current vaccination thresholds. The evidence is based on a mathematical model and real-world outbreak data, with implications for public health policy. The analysis is grounded in the model's assumptions and observed epidemic characteristics, though the study does not provide detailed statistical methods or experimental validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 近期的证据表明,疫苗诱导的免疫力可能会随时间减弱,这挑战了传统上认为免疫力终身存在的假设。我们开发了一个关于麻疹 传播和疫苗接种的数学模型,该模型明确纳入了免疫力减弱的因素,并推导出更新后的疫苗接种阈值($$p_c$$)和控制再生数($$R_c$$)的表达式,这两个指标是指导公共卫生疫苗接种政策的关键参数。我们还推导了暴发概率和最终暴发规模的方程。我们将该模型应用于2024-2025年麻疹 暴发在西南安大略公共卫生地区的情况,并报告了符合观察到的疫情特征的可行参数集所对应的基线再生数($$R_0$$)范围、暴发峰值时间与规模、最终暴发规模以及参与传播的人口规模。最重要的是,我们的分析表明,即使疫苗诱导的免疫力减弱极其缓慢——实际上相当于终身保护——也可能从根本上改变群体免疫的动态。具体而言,在模型假设下,我们识别出一些现实的参数范围,在这些范围内,尽管疫苗接种率很高,但无法实现疫苗诱导的群体免疫。然而,在这些条件下,暴发的风险可能仍然非常低。这些发现表明,在高疫苗接种率人群中,广泛使用的麻疹群体免疫阈值可能需要重新评估。

papers.title: Measles Vaccination, Population Immunity and Epidemiology in Northern Saudi Arabia: A Scoping Review with Cross-Border Context from Iraq and Jordan
papers.abstract: Background and rationale Measles remains an important vaccine-preventable infectious disease, particularly in populations with incomplete vaccination coverage, declining immunity, or surveillance systems that struggle to identify and respond to outbreaks. Although routine immunization has substantially reduced measles transmission in many settings, outbreaks continue to occur when susceptible individuals accumulate within communities. Differences in vaccination uptake, population movement, access to healthcare, and the effectiveness of surveillance and outbreak-response activities may shape the distribution of measles susceptibility and outbreak risk. In Saudi Arabia, national immunization programs have helped control measles. However, national-level indicators may not adequately reflect variations in vaccination coverage and population immunity across individual regions. Northern Saudi Arabia is of particular interest because of its distinct geographical and population characteristics and its proximity to neighboring countries, including Iraq and Jordan. Evidence from these neighboring countries may provide useful epidemiological context for understanding regional measles patterns, vaccination challenges, and population immunity. Nevertheless, geographical proximity alone does not establish cross-border transmission, and evidence from Iraq and Jordan will therefore be considered contextual rather than direct evidence of transmission into Saudi Arabia. A systematic mapping of the available evidence is needed to identify what is known about measles epidemiology, vaccination coverage, immunity, and surveillance in Northern Saudi Arabia, while highlighting relevant findings from Iraq and Jordan. This review will also identify geographical and thematic evidence gaps that may inform future research, public health planning, and immunization strategies. Purpose and objectives The purpose of this scoping review is to map and synthesize the available evidence on measles vaccination, population immunity, and epidemiology in Northern Saudi Arabia, with contextual consideration of relevant evidence from Iraq and Jordan. The specific objectives are to: 1. Describe the reported epidemiology of measles in Northern Saudi Arabia, including incidence, prevalence, outbreak occurrence, and temporal patterns. Map available evidence on measles vaccination coverage, vaccine uptake, and immunization practices in the target regions. Identify studies reporting measles seroprevalence, serological evidence of immunity, vaccine-induced immune responses, and immunity gaps among relevant population groups. Examine reported factors associated with measles susceptibility, incomplete vaccination, and inadequate population immunity. Summarise available evidence on measles surveillance, outbreak detection, investigation, and public health response. Review relevant epidemiological, vaccination, and population-immunity evidence from Iraq and Jordan to provide a cross-border regional context. Identify geographical, population-specific, methodological, and evidence gaps requiring further investigation. Methods and scope The review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology for scoping reviews and will be reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). The review will use the Population–Concept–Context (PCC) framework to guide eligibility criteria and evidence selection. The geographical focus will be Northern Saudi Arabia, particularly the Northern Borders, Al-Jouf, Ha'il, and Tabuk regions. Relevant evidence from Iraq and Jordan will be included to provide additional regional context. Studies conducted elsewhere in Saudi Arabia will be considered only when findings specific to the target northern regions can be identified or extracted. The review will consider evidence relating to measles epidemiology, vaccination coverage and uptake, seroprevalence, population immunity, outbreak occurrence, surveillance, and associated determinants. No restrictions will be imposed on age groups or study designs. Eligible English-language publications from 1 January 2010 onwards will be considered. The search strategy will cover relevant published literature, with the search period extending to 18 November 2026. Records will undergo screening against the predefined eligibility criteria. Relevant data will be charted using a structured data-extraction approach and summarised descriptively and thematically. Findings will be presented using appropriate tables, narrative summaries, and geographical or thematic groupings where the available evidence permits. Expected outcomes and significance The review is expected to provide a structured overview of the available evidence on measles epidemiology, vaccination, and population immunity in Northern Saudi Arabia. It will identify reported outbreaks and epidemiological patterns, describe the available evidence on vaccination coverage and immunity, and highlight population groups or geographical areas for which evidence suggests potential susceptibility or inadequate protection. The inclusion of evidence from Iraq and Jordan is expected to provide a broader regional perspective on measles epidemiology and immunisation challenges. However, the review will distinguish contextual regional findings from evidence directly relating to Northern Saudi Arabia and will not assume that geographical proximity demonstrates cross-border transmission. The findings are expected to: i. Identify areas where evidence on measles vaccination and population immunity is limited or inconsistent. Highlight potential gaps in regional surveillance, epidemiological reporting, and immunization coverage data. Identify population groups and geographical settings that may warrant further epidemiological or serological investigation. Provide an evidence base to support regional immunization planning, surveillance strengthening, and outbreak preparedness. Inform future research priorities, including studies of measles seroprevalence, vaccine coverage, and immunity gaps in underserved or inadequately studied populations. Ultimately, this scoping review will provide a consolidated account of the available evidence and clarify where additional research and public health attention are needed to sustain measles control and strengthen preparedness in Northern Saudi Arabia and its wider regional context.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 疫苗接种,北部沙特阿拉伯地区群体免疫与 流行病学:一项包含伊拉克和约旦跨境背景的范围综述
papers.source_body_en: Background and rationale Measles remains an important vaccine-preventable infectious disease, particularly in populations with incomplete vaccination coverage, declining immunity, or surveillance systems that struggle to identify and respond to outbreaks. Although routine immunization has substantially reduced measles transmission in many settings, outbreaks continue to occur when susceptible individuals accumulate within communities. Differences in vaccination uptake, population movement, access to healthcare, and the effectiveness of surveillance and outbreak-response activities may shape the distribution of measles susceptibility and outbreak risk. In Saudi Arabia, national immunization programs have helped control measles. However, national-level indicators may not adequately reflect variations in vaccination coverage and population immunity across individual regions. Northern Saudi Arabia is of particular interest because of its distinct geographical and population characteristics and its proximity to neighboring countries, including Iraq and Jordan. Evidence from these neighboring countries may provide useful epidemiological context for understanding regional measles patterns, vaccination challenges, and population immunity. Nevertheless, geographical proximity alone does not establish cross-border transmission, and evidence from Iraq and Jordan will therefore be considered contextual rather than direct evidence of transmission into Saudi Arabia. A systematic mapping of the available evidence is needed to identify what is known about measles epidemiology, vaccination coverage, immunity, and surveillance in Northern Saudi Arabia, while highlighting relevant findings from Iraq and Jordan. This review will also identify geographical and thematic evidence gaps that may inform future research, public health planning, and immunization strategies. Purpose and objectives The purpose of this scoping review is to map and synthesize the available evidence on measles vaccination, population immunity, and epidemiology in Northern Saudi Arabia, with contextual consideration of relevant evidence from Iraq and Jordan. The specific objectives are to: 1. Describe the reported epidemiology of measles in Northern Saudi Arabia, including incidence, prevalence, outbreak occurrence, and temporal patterns. Map available evidence on measles vaccination coverage, vaccine uptake, and immunization practices in the target regions. Identify studies reporting measles seroprevalence, serological evidence of immunity, vaccine-induced immune responses, and immunity gaps among relevant population groups. Examine reported factors associated with measles susceptibility, incomplete vaccination, and inadequate population immunity. Summarise available evidence on measles surveillance, outbreak detection, investigation, and public health response. Review relevant epidemiological, vaccination, and population-immunity evidence from Iraq and Jordan to provide a cross-border regional context. Identify geographical, population-specific, methodological, and evidence gaps requiring further investigation. Methods and scope The review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology for scoping reviews and will be reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). The review will use the Population–Concept–Context (PCC) framework to guide eligibility criteria and evidence selection. The geographical focus will be Northern Saudi Arabia, particularly the Northern Borders, Al-Jouf, Ha'il, and Tabuk regions. Relevant evidence from Iraq and Jordan will be included to provide additional regional context. Studies conducted elsewhere in Saudi Arabia will be considered only when findings specific to the target northern regions can be identified or extracted. The review will consider evidence relating to measles epidemiology, vaccination coverage and uptake, seroprevalence, population immunity, outbreak occurrence, surveillance, and associated determinants. No restrictions will be imposed on age groups or study designs. Eligible English-language publications from 1 January 2010 onwards will be considered. The search strategy will cover relevant published literature, with the search period extending to 18 November 2026. Records will undergo screening against the predefined eligibility criteria. Relevant data will be charted using a structured data-extraction approach and summarised descriptively and thematically. Findings will be presented using appropriate tables, narrative summaries, and geographical or thematic groupings where the available evidence permits. Expected outcomes and significance The review is expected to provide a structured overview of the available evidence on measles epidemiology, vaccination, and population immunity in Northern Saudi Arabia. It will identify reported outbreaks and epidemiological patterns, describe the available evidence on vaccination coverage and immunity, and highlight population groups or geographical areas for which evidence suggests potential susceptibility or inadequate protection. The inclusion of evidence from Iraq and Jordan is expected to provide a broader regional perspective on measles epidemiology and immunisation challenges. However, the review will distinguish contextual regional findings from evidence directly relating to Northern Saudi Arabia and will not assume that geographical proximity demonstrates cross-border transmission. The findings are expected to: i. Identify areas where evidence on measles vaccination and population immunity is limited or inconsistent. Highlight potential gaps in regional surveillance, epidemiological reporting, and immunization coverage data. Identify population groups and geographical settings that may warrant further epidemiological or serological investigation. Provide an evidence base to support regional immunization planning, surveillance strengthening, and outbreak preparedness. Inform future research priorities, including studies of measles seroprevalence, vaccine coverage, and immunity gaps in underserved or inadequately studied populations. Ultimately, this scoping review will provide a consolidated account of the available evidence and clarify where additional research and public health attention are needed to sustain measles control and strengthen preparedness in Northern Saudi Arabia and its wider regional context.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景和理由麻疹仍然是一个重要的疫苗可预防的传染病,特别是在免疫不完整、免疫力下降或监测系统难以识别和应对暴发的人群中。尽管常规免疫接种在许多地区显著降低了麻疹的发病率,但当易感个体在社区中积累时,暴发仍然会发生。不同人群的疫苗接种接受率、人口流动、获得医疗服务的机会以及监测和暴发应对活动的有效性可能会影响麻疹易感性和暴发风险的分布。在沙特阿拉伯,国家免疫计划有助于控制麻疹。然而,国家层面的指标可能无法充分反映不同地区疫苗接种覆盖和人群免疫力的差异。北部沙特阿拉伯因其独特的地理和人口特征以及与邻国伊拉克和约旦的接近性而特别引人关注。来自这些邻国的证据可以为理解区域麻疹模式、疫苗接种挑战和人群免疫力提供有用的流行病学背景。然而,地理接近性本身并不能证明跨境传播,因此来自伊拉克和约旦的证据将被视为背景而非直接证据。需要系统地映射现有证据,以了解关于麻疹的流行病学、疫苗接种覆盖、免疫力和监测在北部沙特阿拉伯的情况,同时突出来自伊拉克和约旦的相关发现。该综述还将识别需要进一步研究的地理、人群特定、方法学和证据空白。目的和目标该综述的目的在于绘制和综合关于麻疹的疫苗接种、人群免疫力和流行病学在北部沙特阿拉伯的现有证据,并考虑来自伊拉克和约旦的相关证据。具体目标包括:1. 描述北部沙特阿拉伯报告的流行病学的麻疹,包括发病率、患病率、暴发的发生和时间模式。绘制关于麻疹的疫苗接种覆盖、疫苗接受和免疫接种实践的现有证据。识别报告麻疹的血清流行率、血清学证据的免疫力、疫苗诱导的免疫应答和相关人群群体中的免疫空白。检查与麻疹易感性、不完全疫苗接种和不足的人群免疫力相关的报告因素。总结关于麻疹的监测、暴发检测、调查和公共卫生应对的现有证据。审查来自伊拉克和约旦的相关流行病学、疫苗接种和人群免疫力证据,以提供跨境区域背景。识别需要进一步调查的地理、人群特定、方法学和证据空白。方法和范围该综述将遵循乔纳森布里格斯研究所(JBI)的范围综述方法,并将根据系统综述和元分析扩展的首选报告项目(PRISMA-ScR)进行报告。该综述将使用人群-概念-背景(PCC)框架来指导资格标准和证据选择。地理重点将放在北部沙特阿拉伯,特别是北部边境、阿吉夫、哈伊尔和塔布克地区。将包括来自伊拉克和约旦的相关证据以提供额外的区域背景。只有当可以识别或提取特定于目标北部地区的发现时,才会考虑沙特阿拉伯其他地区的研究。该综述将考虑与麻疹的流行病学、疫苗接种覆盖和接受、血清流行率、人群免疫力、暴发的发生、监测及其相关决定因素相关的证据。不会对年龄组或研究设计施加限制。将考虑自2010年1月1日起发表的英文语言出版物。搜索策略将涵盖相关出版文献,搜索期将延续至2026年11月18日。记录将根据预定义的资格标准进行筛选。相关数据将使用结构化数据提取方法进行记录,并进行描述性和主题性总结。结果将根据可用证据进行适当分组,以表格、叙述性摘要或地理或主题分组形式呈现。预期结果和意义该综述预计会提供关于麻疹的流行病学、疫苗接种和人群免疫力在北部沙特阿拉伯的结构化概述。它将识别报告的暴发和流行病学模式,描述关于疫苗接种覆盖和免疫力的现有证据,并突出需要进一步流行病学或血清学调查的人群群体或地理区域。包括来自伊拉克和约旦的证据预计会提供关于麻疹的流行病学和免疫接种挑战的更广泛区域视角。然而,该综述将区分区域背景发现和直接与北部沙特阿拉伯相关的证据,并不会假设地理接近性证明了跨境传播。结果预计包括:i. 识别关于麻疹的疫苗接种和人群免疫力的证据有限或不一致的领域。突出区域监测、流行病学报告和免疫接种覆盖率数据中的潜在空白。识别需要进一步流行病学或血清学调查的人群群体和地理区域。为区域免疫规划、监测加强和暴发准备提供证据基础。指导未来研究优先事项,包括对未充分研究或未充分研究人群的麻疹的血清流行率、疫苗覆盖率和免疫空白的研究。最终,该范围综述将提供现有证据的综合概述,并澄清在北部沙特阿拉伯及其更广泛区域背景下需要额外研究和公共卫生关注的领域,以维持麻疹的控制和加强准备。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 麻疹仍然是一个重要的疫苗可预防的传染病,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率不完全、免疫力下降或免疫系统难以识别和应对暴发的人群中。本综述旨在绘制和综合有关麻疹疫苗接种、人群免疫力和流行病学在北沙特阿拉伯的现有证据,并结合伊拉克和约旦的相关证据进行背景分析。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次综述将遵循Joanna Briggs研究所(JBI)的范围综述方法学,并按照范围综述的首选报告项目(PRISMA-ScR)进行报告。本次综述将采用人群-概念-背景(PCC)框架来指导纳入标准和证据选择。地理范围将聚焦于沙特阿拉伯北部,特别是北方边境、Al-Jouf、Ha'il和Tabuk地区。相关数据将采用结构化的数据提取方法进行图表展示,并进行描述性及主题性总结。纳入标准为2010年1月1日以后发表的英文文献。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 流行病学、监测、疫苗接种的摄入差异、人口流动、医疗资源获取以及暴发响应活动的效果可能会塑造麻疹易感性与暴发风险的分布。研究结果将通过适当的表格、叙述性摘要以及在可用证据允许的情况下,按地理或主题分组的方式呈现。该综述预计将提供关于北方沙特阿拉伯地区麻疹、流行病学、疫苗接种以及人群免疫力的现有证据的结构化概述。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 地理邻近性本身并不能确立跨境传播,因此伊拉克和约旦的证据将被视为上下文证据,而非直接证明传播传入沙特阿拉伯的证据。该综述将识别需要进一步研究的地理、人群特异性、方法学和证据方面的空白。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要对现有证据进行系统性梳理,以确定在北沙特阿拉伯关于麻疹、流行病学、疫苗接种的覆盖范围、免疫应答以及监测的相关知识,同时突出伊拉克和约旦的相关研究发现。本综述还将识别地理和主题方面的证据缺口,以指导未来的研究、公共卫生规划和疫苗接种策略。

papers.title: Sensitivity of Measles Real-time Reverse-transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction Testing During an Outbreak in Persons Without Rash.
papers.abstract: During the 2024 Chicago measles outbreak, 120 real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction tests were performed on 117 symptomatic persons with measles exposure, but without rash; test sensitivity was 78% (7 true positive). After an initial negative test, providers should maintain suspicion of measles and repeat testing as symptoms progress.

papers.title_original: Sensitivity of Measles Real-time Reverse-transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction Testing During an Outbreak in Persons Without Rash.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the sensitivity of measles real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) testing in individuals exposed to measles but without rash during an outbreak, addressing the challenge of diagnosing measles in the absence of the characteristic rash.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted during the 2024 Chicago measles outbreak and involved 117 symptomatic persons with measles exposure but without rash, with 120 RT-PCR tests performed on them.
analysis.methods: Real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) testing was used to detect measles virus RNA in specimens from symptomatic individuals without rash, with testing repeated if initial results were negative.
analysis.main_results: The sensitivity of measles RT-PCR testing was reported as 78%, with 7 true positive results out of 120 tests performed.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the sensitivity of measles real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) testing in individuals exposed to measles but without rash during the 2024 Chicago outbreak. A total of 120 RT-PCR tests were conducted on 117 symptomatic individuals, yielding a sensitivity of 78% with 7 true positive results. The authors emphasize the need for repeated testing in such cases, as initial negative results do not rule out measles infection. The findings suggest that RT-PCR testing remains a valuable tool for diagnosing measles in non-rash presentations, which can improve surveillance and early detection during outbreaks. However, the study's observational design and potential for false negatives limit the confidence in its conclusions. The evidence is considered strong due to the direct observation of test results in a real-world outbreak setting.

papers.title: Characterizing Measles Healthcare Facility Exposures-December 2023 Through September 2025: New York City.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: When people develop measles (cases), healthcare facility exposures are common and result in many potentially exposed people requiring resource-intensive control measures. We summarized exposures and transmission among people exposed to measles (contacts) in healthcare settings in New York City (NYC). METHODS: NYC Health Department's surveillance data of NYC contacts exposed to measles cases in any NYC healthcare facility during December 2023-September 2025 were analyzed as a retrospective descriptive study. Characteristics summarized included measles transmission, immunity status, postexposure prophylaxis (PEP) administration, facility setting, and time of measles exposure. RESULTS: Of 2122 healthcare contacts to 28 cases, no secondary cases occurred. 1285 (60.6%) were vaccinated or had other evidence of immunity, 618 (29.1%) were adults with unknown immunity, 124 (5.8%) were not immune and received PEP, and 95 (4.5%) were not immune and did not receive PEP. Most contacts were exposed in emergency departments and/or hospital inpatient settings (1406; 66.3%). Among 1028 contacts with known time of exposure (48.4% of all contacts), 785 (76.4%) overlapped with the case in the healthcare facility, 146 (14.2%) arrived within 1 hour, and 97 (9.4%) arrived 1-2 hours after the case left or were isolated. CONCLUSIONS: Most contacts exposed to measles in NYC healthcare facilities had presumptive immunity or were adults with unknown immunity. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在总结在纽约市(NYC)医疗机构中接触麻疹病例的接触者的暴露情况和传播,以应对常见的医疗机构暴露和资源密集型的控制措施需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性描述性研究分析了纽约市卫生部门在2023年12月至2025年9月期间,所有在纽约市医疗机构中接触麻疹病例的接触者的监测数据。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用纽约市卫生部门的监测数据,分析接触麻疹病例的接触者特征,包括麻疹暴露时间、免疫状态、暴露后预防(PEP)措施、机构环境以及暴露时间。
elements_zh.main_results: 在28例病例的2122名医疗接触者中,未发生二次病例。1285名(60.6%)已接种疫苗或有其他免疫证据,618名(29.1%)为免疫状态未知的成年人,124名(5.8%)无免疫力且接受了暴露后预防(PEP),95名(4.5%)无免疫力且未接受PEP。大多数接触者是在急诊科和/或医院住院环境中暴露的(1406名;66.3%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现,大多数在纽约市医疗机构中接触麻疹的接触者具有推测性免疫或为免疫状态未知的成年人,并且在2122名接触者中未发现任何传播病例,包括无免疫力的接触者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,仅依赖基于时间的麻疹暴露定义可能过于宽泛,而结合策略如医疗机构空气交换数据,可能更准确地评估传播风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计以及可能存在未测量的混杂因素。证据强度为中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the resurgence of measles cases in 2026, highlighting the need for updated public health strategies to combat this highly contagious viral disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a descriptive analysis of measles outbreaks and vaccination rates across various regions in 2026, focusing on the global increase in cases and the associated public health challenges.
analysis.methods: The study compiles and analyzes global measles case data from public health reports and vaccination coverage statistics to identify trends and patterns in disease transmission and control.
analysis.main_results: The evidence reports that measles cases in 2026 are the highest in 35 years, indicating a significant resurgence of the disease.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the increase in cases as a reflection of declining vaccination rates and potential gaps in disease surveillance, emphasizing the novelty of the situation in the context of recent global health efforts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage and improving surveillance systems to prevent further outbreaks and mitigate the public health impact of measles.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on aggregated data and does not include detailed statistical analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment based on the available evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the resurgence of measles cases in 2026, noting that they are the highest in 35 years. The research focuses on the global increase in measles outbreaks and the associated public health challenges, emphasizing the need for updated vaccination strategies and improved surveillance. The authors interpret the rise in cases as a result of declining vaccination rates and gaps in disease monitoring, which underscores the importance of maintaining high immunization coverage to prevent further spread. While the study provides a descriptive overview, its reliance on aggregated data limits the depth of analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment. The findings inform ongoing efforts to address measles outbreaks and reinforce the necessity of robust public health interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究探讨了2026年麻疹病例的回升现象,强调需要更新公共卫生策略以应对这种高度传染性的病毒性疾病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对2026年不同地区麻疹、暴发和疫苗接种率的描述性分析,重点关注全球病例数的增加以及相关的公共卫生挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究汇总并分析了来自公共卫生报告和疫苗接种覆盖率统计数据的全球麻疹病例数据,以识别疾病传播和控制方面的趋势和模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 证据表明,2026年的麻疹病例数是35年来最高水平,表明该疾病出现了显著回升。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将病例数的增加解释为疫苗接种覆盖率下降以及疾病监测潜在缺口的反映,强调了在最近全球卫生努力背景下这一情况的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了保持高疫苗接种覆盖率和改善监测系统以防止进一步暴发并减轻麻疹对公共卫生影响的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于汇总数据,未包含详细的统计分析,因此基于现有证据的置信度评估为中等。

papers.title: Mathematical Modelling of Measles Transmission with Alternative Childhood Vaccination-Entry Pathways in Kilifi County, Kenya: A Five-compartment Threshold, Sensitivity and Numerical Scenario Analysis
papers.abstract: Measles transmission depends on susceptibility, the extent of childhood immunisation and the timing of vaccine receipt. A deterministic five-compartment model was developed to investigate alternative vaccination-entry pathways using annual measles-related tabulations for children younger than ten years in Kilifi County, Kenya, during 2015–2024 as descriptive context and as numerical initial-state weights. The model comprises susceptible, delayed-entry vaccination, immediate-entry vaccination, infectious and recovered/immune classes. Positivity, boundedness, disease-free and endemic equilibria, local stability and normalised forward sensitivity were examined; adaptive Runge–Kutta integration was used to compare entry scenarios. For the fixed theoretical baseline, the vaccination-adjusted reproduction threshold was Rv = 7.7534, the disease-free equilibrium was locally unstable and the positive endemic equilibrium was locally asymptotically stable. Recruitment and mass-action transmission each had elasticity + 1.0000, whereas immediate- and delayed-entry elasticities were -0.5791 and -0.2207 . After nine years, the reference-scaled infectious state was 0.000922 without new entry, 0.000891 with delayed entry alone and 0.000845 with immediate entry alone. At the same total vaccination-entry coefficient of 0.0229 year -1, the two pathway allocations gave nearly identical final infectious states ( 0.000818887 and 0.000818905). The matched-entry comparison demonstrates how overall entry intensity and pathway allocation exert different effects in this theoretical system. The pathway classes are mathematical entry categories rather than measured distributions of vaccination delay.
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Pure and Applied Mathematics

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解替代的儿童疫苗接种进入途径如何影响麻疹 传播动态,基于已知麻疹 传播依赖于易感性、儿童免疫接种程度以及疫苗的接收时间这一已有知识。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了一个确定性的五类模型,利用2015年至2024年间肯尼亚基利菲县儿童(年龄小于10岁)的年度麻疹相关统计数据作为描述性背景和数值初始状态权重,以研究替代的疫苗接种进入途径。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型包括易感者、延迟进入疫苗接种、即时进入疫苗接种、感染者和恢复/免疫者类别。研究了正性、有界性、无病平衡和流行平衡、局部稳定性以及归一化前向敏感性;采用自适应Runge–Kutta积分方法比较不同进入情景。
elements_zh.main_results: 在固定的理论基线情况下,调整后的疫苗接种繁殖阈值为Rv = 7.7534,无病平衡是局部不稳定的,而正流行平衡是局部渐近稳定的。招募和质量作用传播各自的弹性均为+1.0000,而即时进入和延迟进入的弹性分别为-0.5791和-0.2207。经过9年后,参考缩放的感染状态在无新进入的情况下为0.000922,在仅有延迟进入的情况下为0.000891,在仅有即时进入的情况下为0.000845。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 途径类别是数学上的进入类别,而非实际测量的疫苗接种延迟分布。匹配进入比较展示了在该理论系统中,总体进入强度和途径分配如何产生不同的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过突出不同疫苗接种进入途径对疾病动态的影响,为麻疹 监测和疫苗接种策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是理论性的,基于数学模型,可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性。由于依赖模拟情景而非实证数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Assessment of progress of measles and rubella elimination strategies in the selected high risk areas of Chikkamagaluru district in Karnataka: a cross sectional study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Measles and rubella (MR) vaccination coverage and MR surveillance were affected by the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, mainly in the years 2020 and 2021. The strategic plan for measles and rubella elimination and sustenance in the World Health Organization (WHO) Southeast Asia region 2024-2028 aims to achieve and sustain measles and rubella elimination. Objective: To assess vaccination coverage of Measles and Rubella (MR) vaccine, pentavalent vaccine, and fractional IPV among children from 1 to 5 years of age and to assess the critical gaps to achieve measles and rubella elimination in the high-risk areas. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among children aged 1 to 5 years in the selected high-risk areas in Chikkamagaluru district for measles-rubella (MR) elimination gap assessment. The data were collected by house-to-house visits using a pre-tested semi-structured questionnaire. The study was conducted for a period of one month. Cluster sampling technique was used. The sample size was 180 children. Inferential statistics were used for data analysis. Results: Coverage of the 1st dose of the MR vaccine was 98.8%, whereas the coverage of the 2nd dose of the MR vaccine was 94.6 %. Coverage of the 3rd dose of fractional IPV was 47.8%. The main reason for missing the 3rd dose of fractional IPV was unavailability of fIPV (74.5%). Conclusion: The vaccination coverage of the 2nd dose of MR vaccine was 94.6 %. Planning level assessment was found to be satisfactory. Keywords: Measles and Rubella vaccine (MR vaccine), Elimination, Coverage, Assessment, Children
papers.journal: International Journal of Community Medicine and Public Health

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the progress of measles and rubella elimination strategies in high-risk areas of Chikkamagaluru district, considering the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on vaccination coverage and surveillance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among children aged 1 to 5 years in selected high-risk areas of Chikkamagaluru district to evaluate measles-rubella (MR) elimination gaps. The study was carried out for one month.
analysis.methods: Data were collected through house-to-house visits using a pre-tested semi-structured questionnaire. Cluster sampling technique was employed to select the sample, which included 180 children.
analysis.main_results: The coverage of the 1st dose of the MR vaccine was 98.8%, while the coverage of the 2nd dose was 94.6%. The coverage of the 3rd dose of fractional IPV was 47.8%, with unavailability of fIPV being the main reason for missing this dose (74.5%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that the planning level assessment for measles and rubella elimination was satisfactory, indicating that the current strategies are on track to achieve the elimination goals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the effectiveness of current measles and rubella elimination strategies in high-risk areas, which can inform targeted interventions to improve vaccination coverage and address gaps.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the potential for self-reporting bias. However, the evidence is strong as it is based on direct data collection from the target population.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed measles and rubella elimination strategies in high-risk areas of Chikkamagaluru district, focusing on vaccination coverage among children aged 1 to 5 years. The study found that the first dose of the measles-rubella (MR) vaccine had a high coverage rate of 98.8%, while the second dose had a coverage of 94.6%. The third dose of fractional IPV had a lower coverage of 47.8%, primarily due to the unavailability of the vaccine. The authors concluded that the planning level assessment was satisfactory, suggesting that current strategies are effective. The study's findings highlight the importance of addressing gaps in vaccination coverage to achieve elimination goals. However, the study's cross-sectional design and potential for self-reporting bias limit the confidence in the results, though the evidence is considered strong due to direct data collection.

papers.title_zh: 卡纳塔克邦奇卡姆加卢尔县选定高风险地区麻疹和风疹消除策略进展评估:一项横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background: Measles and rubella (MR) vaccination coverage and MR surveillance were affected by the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, mainly in the years 2020 and 2021. The strategic plan for measles and rubella elimination and sustenance in the World Health Organization (WHO) Southeast Asia region 2024-2028 aims to achieve and sustain measles and rubella elimination. Objective: To assess vaccination coverage of Measles and Rubella (MR) vaccine, pentavalent vaccine, and fractional IPV among children from 1 to 5 years of age and to assess the critical gaps to achieve measles and rubella elimination in the high-risk areas. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among children aged 1 to 5 years in the selected high-risk areas in Chikkamagaluru district for measles-rubella (MR) elimination gap assessment. The data were collected by house-to-house visits using a pre-tested semi-structured questionnaire. The study was conducted for a period of one month. Cluster sampling technique was used. The sample size was 180 children. Inferential statistics were used for data analysis. Results: Coverage of the 1st dose of the MR vaccine was 98.8%, whereas the coverage of the 2nd dose of the MR vaccine was 94.6 %. Coverage of the 3rd dose of fractional IPV was 47.8%. The main reason for missing the 3rd dose of fractional IPV was unavailability of fIPV (74.5%). Conclusion: The vaccination coverage of the 2nd dose of MR vaccine was 94.6 %. Planning level assessment was found to be satisfactory. Keywords: Measles and Rubella vaccine (MR vaccine), Elimination, Coverage, Assessment, Children

papers.title: Kindergarten MMR Coverage, Vaccination Exemptions, and State-Level Measles Incidence in the United States, 2024 - 2026
papers.abstract: To examine associations of kindergarten measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) coverage and vaccination exemptions with state-level measles incidence in the United States, 2024-2026. In this ecological study of 50 states and Washington, DC (up to 153 jurisdiction-years), we linked CDC surveillance, SchoolVaxView, and Census data. Negative-binomial models estimated incidence rate ratios (IRRs) per percentage-point increase for completed years 2024-2025 (generalized estimating equations) and through MMWR week 39, 2024-2026 (maximum likelihood, adjusted for density and poverty). Cases rose from 269 (2024) to 2,263 (2025); 3,642 were reported provisionally through October 2, 2026. Completed-year IRRs were 0.875 (95% CI=0.806, 0.950) for MMR coverage, 1.202 (1.075, 1.344) for any exemption, and 1.207 (1.059, 1.376) for nonmedical exemption. Adjusted week-39 IRRs were 0.945 (0.837, 1.068), 1.147 (1.004, 1.310), and 1.131 (0.972, 1.316). Under cluster-robust maximum likelihood, completed-year intervals for MMR coverage and nonmedical exemption included 1. Higher exemption prevalence was associated with greater measles incidence; other estimates were imprecise. Public Health Implications. Monitoring exemptions alongside MMR coverage may help identify jurisdictions needing closer vaccination-gap assessment. Ecological findings do not establish causality.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between kindergarten measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage and exemptions with state-level measles incidence in the United States from 2024 to 2026. Using an ecological design, the researchers linked CDC surveillance, SchoolVaxView, and Census data across 50 states and Washington, DC. Negative-binomial models estimated incidence rate ratios (IRRs) per percentage-point increase in MMR coverage and exemptions, adjusting for density and poverty. The results showed a rise in measles cases from 269 in 2024 to 2,263 in 2025, with 3,642 provisional reports by October 2, 2026. Completed-year IRRs indicated that higher exemption prevalence was associated with increased measles incidence, while other estimates were imprecise. The study highlights the importance of monitoring vaccination exemptions alongside MMR coverage to identify jurisdictions needing closer assessment of vaccination gaps. However, the ecological design limits the ability to establish causality, and the confidence in the findings is moderate due to the observational nature of the data.
